scope: Additive Royal Champion Haste Vial L1-18 active movement/attack speed and passive attack cadence audit.
game_version: Official February and April 2024 release/balance; dated secondary claimed client build 18.600.3; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: February 2024 Update - Patch Notes
facts: Haste Vial unlocks at Blacksmith level 8 and increases Royal Champion movement and attack speed for a few seconds.
sources.limitations: No current level table, activation phase, movement units or attack interval conversion is specified.

sources.title: Temperamental Tentacles Update!
facts: Official table reduces L9-18 Attack Speed Increase to 10,11,12,12,13,14,14,15,16,16; pinned raw matches those values.
A bug causing Royal Champion attacks to do less damage while Haste Vial ability was active was fixed.
sources.limitations: The table does not define cadence formula, rounding or damage stage; no later continuity statement is supplied.

sources.title: Haste Vial — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: Dated table matches pinned L1-18 Champion DPS bonus 20-88 and ore costs.
sources.limitations: Does not publish current active movement/attack speed, duration, or passive cadence.

sources.title: Pinned Haste Vial Home Village Hero Equipment record
facts: Pinned active duration is 7-10 seconds, movement speedIncrease 18-38.3 in unspecified units, active attack-speed increase 60-100%, passive attack-speed increase 5-16%, and DPS bonus 20-88.
sources.limitations: Numeric movement units, exact attack interval conversion, modifier stacking, rounding and tick order are absent.

derivations.result: Retain pinned duration and modifier fields as catalogue provenance; L9-18 passive percentages match the official April 2024 table
derivations.method: Compare the raw L1-18 series, April 2024 balance table and dated 2026 DPS/ore table without deriving a tick cadence from percentage labels.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat raw speedIncrease 18-38.3 as tiles per second or use floating delta time
rejected_inferences.reason: The payload does not define units or a fixed-tick integer path conversion; combat must remain 10 ms integer-timed.

rejected_inferences.rule: Reduce every attack interval by the listed active percentage with ordinary floating division
rejected_inferences.reason: Attack-speed increase does not specify baseline, rounding, projectile carryover or expiry tick behavior.

rejected_inferences.rule: Add passive and active attack-speed percentages directly
rejected_inferences.reason: Modifier composition, damage/cadence stage and stacking with other Equipment are not published.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply the pre-April 2024 L9-18 passive values
rejected_inferences.reason: The official table lowered these levels, and pinned raw matches the new values.

rejected_inferences.rule: Grant Haste Spell aura to nearby units
rejected_inferences.reason: The official Equipment release says it increases the Royal Champion's own speed.

items: current duration and active movement/attack-speed continuity
movement speed units, fixed-tick path conversion and collision
passive/active attack cadence formula, rounding and launched-projectile carryover
DPS bonus timing, damage stage and attack-speed stacking
activation, first boosted attack, expiry, death, Pet and other Equipment order
Viewer speed effect, snapshot, replay and RL loadout state

conclusion: Haste Vial L1-18 remains partial and catalogue-only. Official sources establish Champion movement and attack-speed boosts and a L9-18 passive balance series matching pinned data, but the speed units, cadence conversion, current active values and fixed-tick order are unresolved. No Equipment Core actor is enabled.
